tools.name: run
tools.description: Run a Linux argv under GuardianAI/Jev. Read the project at /workspace/source and prior results at /workspace/results/step-NNN. Read task-approved /protected/NAME directly as a byte snapshot: these paths are virtual, so stat, exists, is_file and directory probes do not establish availability. Do not infer child paths. Write new files only in /output; /tmp is private scratch. Each call has a fresh isolated process tree and empty /output. Results become read-only history for later calls. No network, host home or observer credentials are available to commands. A stopped scope cannot run further commands.

finish.description: Set true on the final command to close this tool session after returning its result. No later commands can run.
